dataset: P6 locked corpus (re-locked 2026-07-07 after cross-batch deduplication)
lock_generation_note: Pooled numbers belong to the v7.1.1 data lock (2026-07-07). Software releases 7.2.0 to 7.2.2 (2026-09-03 to 2026-09-23) fix the post-extraction path and the API access control; they do not re-lock the corpus. Re-coding of t/beta-derived records under formula corrections A1-A3 and the six provisional ICRV codes are pending; any re-issue is a new lock generation with a new version DOI.
duplicate_version_note: Zenodo archived v7.2.2 twice because the GitHub release was first published under the mistyped tag V7.2.2. Both records hold commit 8af4881; cite 10.5281/zenodo.22920619.
manual_deposit_note: Separate Zenodo deposit of v7.1.1 made by hand on 2026-07-09 (version DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21282517). Cited by the dissertation and by the copyright-registration dossier; stays published and always resolves to v7.1.1.
